title: Senior Content Marketing Manager, Merchant - EMEA
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. The role   Help merchants get more from their partnership with Wolt and Deliveroo.   Reporting to the EMEA B2B Content Team Lead, you will own merchant content programmes across both brands, with a particular focus on helping existing merchants improve their operations, discover opportunities and grow their businesses.   You will identify the merchant problems worth addressing, develop the content strategy and lead delivery with colleagues across Marketing, Commercial, Operations and Product. You will also write and edit the content yourself, combining strong editorial judgement with clear ownership of performance.   Your core portfolio will include merchant editorial content, customer stories, thought leadership and campaigns that support merchant success. This is a senior individual contributor role with responsibility for setting priorities, leading programmes and demonstrating their impact.   What you will own   Merchant editorial programmes. Build and manage a focused content plan across both brands, including the merchant blog, practical business guidance and thought leadership. Use merchant research, frontline feedback and performance data to decide what deserves investment. Merchant stories and proof. Develop a repeatable case-study programme, from identifying merchants and conducting interviews to securing evidence, approvals and reusable assets. Merchant campaigns. Lead the content strategy and delivery for agreed merchant initiatives, including operational improvements and relevant seasonal occasions. Establish the audience, desired action, content approach, responsibilities and measures before production begins. Content creation and quality. Write and edit compelling content across articles, reports, case studies, email and campaign assets. Brief designers, freelancers and other contributors where needed. Delivery across brands and markets. Coordinate stakeholders, approvals and localisation, adapting content to the needs of each brand and market. Performance and improvement. Set baselines and targets with the relevant teams, monitor results and use them to improve, expand or stop content activity.   How you will work   You will partner with Growth on website and acquisition content, with GTM on priority launches and with CRM on merchant communications. Those teams own their respective strategies and channel execution; you will own the agreed content programme and its contribution.   Within Content, you will collaborate with the owners of merchant education, Ads & Promos, Commerce Platform and social. The Team Lead will continue to lead priority event content during the transition; you may develop stories or campaigns from those events where they support your portfolio.   What success looks like   You will be accountable for three areas, with targets agreed once baselines and tracking are established:   Merchant action: the proportion of merchants who take the intended next step after engaging with your content, where tracking allows. Useful engagement: meaningful consumption of priority content, measured through relevant indicators such as engaged reading, completion or repeat engagement. Use of merchant proof: adoption and reuse of case studies and evidence by Commercial and Marketing, with feedback on their effectiveness.   You will report what is working, what is not and what you recommend changing. Wider retention and growth outcomes will be shared with the teams responsible for them.   What you will bring   A track record of independently building and improving B2B content programmes, with examples of measurable results. Excellent writing, editing and interviewing skills, supported by a portfolio of substantive work such as case studies, editorial programmes, reports or campaigns. Experience leading campaigns across functions, including setting priorities, resolving competing requests and coordinating delivery. Confidence using analytics and research to make decisions, define success and explain the limits of attribution. Strong commercial judgement and the ability to turn complex product or operational information into useful merchant content. Experience adapting content across markets, working with specialists and managing external contributors. The role

 

Help merchants get more from their partnership with Wolt and Deliveroo.

 

Reporting to the EMEA B2B Content Team Lead, you will own merchant content programmes across both brands, with a particular focus on helping existing merchants improve their operations, discover opportunities and grow their businesses.

 

You will identify the merchant problems worth addressing, develop the content strategy and lead delivery with colleagues across Marketing, Commercial, Operations and Product. You will also write and edit the content yourself, combining strong editorial judgement with clear ownership of performance.

 

Your core portfolio will include merchant editorial content, customer stories, thought leadership and campaigns that support merchant success. This is a senior individual contributor role with responsibility for setting priorities, leading programmes and demonstrating their impact.

 

What you will own

 

  • Merchant editorial programmes. Build and manage a focused content plan across both brands, including the merchant blog, practical business guidance and thought leadership. Use merchant research, frontline feedback and performance data to decide what deserves investment.

  • Merchant stories and proof. Develop a repeatable case-study programme, from identifying merchants and conducting interviews to securing evidence, approvals and reusable assets.

  • Merchant campaigns. Lead the content strategy and delivery for agreed merchant initiatives, including operational improvements and relevant seasonal occasions. Establish the audience, desired action, content approach, responsibilities and measures before production begins.

  • Content creation and quality. Write and edit compelling content across articles, reports, case studies, email and campaign assets. Brief designers, freelancers and other contributors where needed.

  • Delivery across brands and markets. Coordinate stakeholders, approvals and localisation, adapting content to the needs of each brand and market.

  • Performance and improvement. Set baselines and targets with the relevant teams, monitor results and use them to improve, expand or stop content activity.

 

How you will work

 

You will partner with Growth on website and acquisition content, with GTM on priority launches and with CRM on merchant communications. Those teams own their respective strategies and channel execution; you will own the agreed content programme and its contribution.

 

Within Content, you will collaborate with the owners of merchant education, Ads & Promos, Commerce Platform and social. The Team Lead will continue to lead priority event content during the transition; you may develop stories or campaigns from those events where they support your portfolio.

 

What success looks like

 

You will be accountable for three areas, with targets agreed once baselines and tracking are established:

 

  • Merchant action: the proportion of merchants who take the intended next step after engaging with your content, where tracking allows.

  • Useful engagement: meaningful consumption of priority content, measured through relevant indicators such as engaged reading, completion or repeat engagement.

  • Use of merchant proof: adoption and reuse of case studies and evidence by Commercial and Marketing, with feedback on their effectiveness.

 

You will report what is working, what is not and what you recommend changing. Wider retention and growth outcomes will be shared with the teams responsible for them.

  • Excellent writing, editing and interviewing skills, supported by a portfolio of substantive work such as case studies, editorial programmes, reports or campaigns.

  • Experience leading campaigns across functions, including setting priorities, resolving competing requests and coordinating delivery.

  • Confidence using analytics and research to make decisions, define success and explain the limits of attribution.

  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to turn complex product or operational information into useful merchant content.

This role sits at the intersection of partnerships and sales — you'll build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders at firms like Accenture, Deloitte, and PwC, and align on joint go-to-market plans. Your main stakeholders will be sales leaders at Anthropic - helping them to land and expand enterprise deals where partner involvement is the difference between winning and not.</p> <p>This is an early-stage motion, which means the playbook is still being written. You'll have real influence over how we engage SIs, what good looks like for a partner-sourced pipeline, and how we equip integrators to build durable Claude practices inside their organizations. You'll report to the Head of Partnerships, North and work closely with Sales, Applied AI Customer Success, and Product to make sure our partners have what they need to close — and to deliver transformative AI solutions for their clients.</p> <h2>Key responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Work directly with Sales Leaders, Account Executives and Applied AI, bringing the partner into the sales cycle at the right moments and ensuring clear roles, clean handoffs, and shared accountability for outcomes</li> <li>Build relationships across multiple levels of the partner organization — from practice leads and delivery teams to alliance executives — and serve as their primary sales/commercial point of contact at Anthropic</li> <li>Own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of assigned SI partners, driving partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue against defined targets</li> <li>Gather signal from partner interactions — what's landing, what's missing, where clients are pushing back — and feed it into product and go-to-market planning</li> <li>Contribute to the development of partner sales processes, playbooks, and best practices as the function scales</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Minimum qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>12+ years of experience in partner sales, channel sales, alliances, or direct sales at a technology company where partners are heavily involved</li> <li>A demonstrated track record of driving revenue through partners or direct sales — you can point to pipeline you built, deals you influenced, and relationships that outlasted any single transaction</li> <li>Strong commercial instincts, including comfort structuring co-sell agreements, navigating multi-party deal dynamics, and knowing when to push and when to let the partner lead</li> <li>Experience operating in early-stage or high-growth environments where processes are still forming and you're expected to help build them</li> <li>Excellent communication and relationship-building skills across all levels, from partner practitioners to alliance executives</li> <li>A collaborative working style — you're energized by cross-functional work and understand that partner sales only works when Sales, Product, and Delivery are aligned</li> <li>Willingness to travel to support partner relationships and joint customer engagements</li> <li>A genuine interest in AI and a belief that advanced AI systems should be developed safely and responsibly</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience working as a direct seller in an Enterprise business and/or a major Systems Integrator, giving you firsthand insight into how these organizations make decisions, staff engagements, and build practices around emerging technology</li> <li>A background in AI, cloud platforms, developer tools, or other categories where technical enablement and differentiation are central to the partner motion</li> <li>Familiarity with consumption-based or API-first business models and how they shape partner economics and incentive design is a plus</li> <li>A history of being an early member of a partner sales function and helping it scale.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Deadline to apply:&nbsp;</strong>None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.&nbsp;</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.&nbsp;</p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£160,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£215,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study:&nbsp;</strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong>&nbsp;We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.&nbsp; Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI &amp; Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2 class="heading"><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic's RL Scaling Science team studies how reinforcement learning behaves as we scale it (across model size, compute, and task horizon) and turns that understanding into the training recipes behind our frontier models. As a Research Engineer on this team, you'll design and run large-scale experiments to understand and resolve bottlenecks, build the benchmarks that make long-horizon progress measurable, and ship validated findings directly into production training.</p> <p>This role lives at the boundary between research and engineering. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.</p> <h2><strong>Compensation</strong></h2> <p>The expected base stipend for this role is 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD per week, with an expectation of 40 hours per week for 4 months (with possible extension).</p> <h2><strong>Across the workstreams, you may be a good fit if you:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole</li> <li>Are excited to transition into empirical AI research and would be interested in a full-time role at Anthropic</li> <li>Have a strong technical background in computer science, mathematics, or physics</li> <li>Thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments</li> <li>Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Strong candidates may also have:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong background in a discipline relevant to a specific Fellows workstream (e.g. economics, social sciences, or cybersecurity)</li> <li>Experience in areas of research or engineering related to their workstream</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Candidates must be:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Fluent in Python programming</li> <li>Available to work full-time on the Fellows program</li> </ul> <h1><strong>AI Safety Fellows</strong></h1> <h2><strong>Mentors, research areas, &amp; past projects</strong></h2> <p>Fellows will undergo a project selection &amp; mentor matching process. <li>Joe Benton</li> <li>Collin Burns</li> <li>Fabien Roger</li> <li>Samuel Marks</li> <li>Kyle Fish</li> <li>Ethan Perez</li> </ul> <p>Our mentors will lead projects in select AI safety research areas, such as:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Scalable Oversight:</strong> Developing techniques to keep highly capable models helpful and honest, even as they surpass human-level intelligence in various Science</a> and <a href="https://red.anthropic.com/">Frontier Red Team</a> blogs, you can read about past projects, including:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://alignment.anthropic.com/2024/anthropic-fellows-program/#:~:text=We're%20launching%20the%20Anthropic,time%20on%20AI%20safety%20research.">Introducing the Anthropic Fellows Program for AI description: <p>The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.</p> <p>Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App.&nbsp;Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p style="text-align: left;" data-speechify-sentence="">The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API,&nbsp;payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50&nbsp;million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.</p> <p style="text-align: left;" data-speechify-sentence="">These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent&nbsp;across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment.&nbsp;Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our&nbsp;request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products&nbsp;depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or&nbsp;someone gets charged twice.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence="">The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of&nbsp;you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one.&nbsp;That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling&nbsp;except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by&nbsp;taking scope and being right about it, fast.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption&nbsp;tracking, and our public TTS API</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it&nbsp;correct after you've moved on</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that&nbsp;freed you up for</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the&nbsp;product is going</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)</li> <li>Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud</li> <li>A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it&nbsp;created</li> <li>A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended,&nbsp;what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone</li> <li>The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual&nbsp;request — rather than against a summary of it</li> <li>Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it</li> <li>A preference for being corrected over being right</li> <li>Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments</li> <li>Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interview process</strong></p> <p>Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to&nbsp;finish within a week.</p> <p>The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this&nbsp;team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk&nbsp;through your reasoning, so bring it.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li>A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li>A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li>Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li>The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li>Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture</li> <li>The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more</li> <li>An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain</li> </ul> <p><strong>Think you’re a good fit for this job?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. <br>And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.</p> <p><strong>Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Refer them!&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Director Care & Clinics Marketing
raw.description:
Light is building the financial foundation for businesses operating across entities and currencies, with AI agents doing routine work and people shaping how the system operates. Our ambition is to become the operating layer for entire industries. Care Homes and Clinics are part of our priority verticals.

We’re looking for a Director Care & Clinics Marketing to build our position in these markets as part of a world-class vertical marketing team. You’ll combine deep customer understanding, a clear industry point of view and commercial judgement to turn an opportunity into a repeatable way to win.

You’ll own market understanding, positioning and the marketing pipeline for Care Homes and Clinics, partnering closely with the Care Sales Manager and Clinics Sales Manager and our shared Product Marketing, Demand Generation and Field Marketing teams.

 

What you’ll do

  • Understand the market and choose where to focus. Interview customers and specialist partners to uncover buying triggers, workflows and unmet needs. Build a shared segment plan with Sales, testing opportunities among groups operating multiple care homes, clinics or practices.

  • Define the proposition. Turn customer insight into clear positioning, competitive arguments and a credible industry point of view. Work with Product Marketing to create customer stories, demonstrations and sales kits that show why Light matters to each segment.

  • Own the marketing pipeline. Build the model, set campaign priorities and lead execution with Demand Generation and Field Marketing. Own weekly reporting on qualified opportunities, conversion and progress against pipeline targets, with clear actions when performance falls short.

  • Make AI part of the operating rhythm. Use AI for research, campaign execution and reporting that gets to the why behind the numbers. Investigate what drives conversion and where deals stall, validate the findings with customer and Sales evidence, and turn them into decisions.

  • Be a true partner to Sales. Train direct sales reps and SDRs on the nuances of Care Homes and Clinics: their buyers, language, workflows and objections. Join important customer conversations and equip the team with the insight and proof needed to move deals forward.

  • Build credibility in the sector. Speak at conferences, webinars and industry discussions. Develop relationships with the press, analysts, influencers and specialist partners who shape how buyers think, bringing a useful perspective grounded in customer experience.

  • Bring the customer voice into the product. Partner with Product Marketing to define the workflows, integrations and product requirements critical to these sectors. Work with Product and customer teams to prioritise needs based on evidence and keep market promises grounded in what Light can deliver.

  • Turn early wins into a repeatable approach. Build customer relationships, lead interviews and capture outcomes that become references and case studies. Use win/loss learning to sharpen our targeting, message and campaigns.

 

What you’ll bring

  • Around ten years of marketing experience, with a strong foundation in industry or product marketing and evidence of building markets and delivering commercial results.

  • Experience owning a marketing pipeline from planning through execution and reporting. You can build a model, understand funnel performance and explain what needs to change.

  • An established ability to speak publicly and tell a compelling industry story, whether on stage, in a customer interview or in conversation with the press, analysts and influencers.

  • Experience working with specialist partners and building trusted relationships within Care Homes, Clinics or a closely related sector.

  • A record of partnering closely with Sales, including training direct reps and SDRs to understand a segment and sell into it with credibility.

  • Experience translating customer needs into clear sector requirements with Product Marketing and Product, distinguishing a recurring market need from a one-off request.

  • Strong analytical curiosity and practical experience using AI to investigate performance, test explanations and improve decisions. You verify the output and can explain the reasoning behind your recommendations.

  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, the judgement to challenge assumptions, and a willingness to do the work yourself: interview customers, write the message, build the campaign and examine the results.

  • You’ll bring enough sector understanding to earn credibility quickly, alongside the curiosity to keep learning. We’re looking for someone who can build a market and a repeatable approach, with customer evidence behind both.

 

What success looks like

Clear priorities for Care Homes and Clinics, positioning that resonates with buyers, and a growing marketing pipeline. Weekly reporting explains what is happening, why it is happening and what the team will do next.

Sales reps and SDRs understand the nuances of each segment and have the training, content and customer proof to progress deals. Customers and specialist partners strengthen our presence in the market, while Product Marketing and Product have a clear, evidence-backed view of the requirements that matter most.

You’ll assess progress through qualified pipeline, conversion, sales-cycle performance and customer outcomes, working with Sales and customer teams to understand delivery effort and time to value.

 

How we work

Light’s values are speed, simplicity and transparency. We make decisions when the evidence is sufficient, keep ownership clear and share progress and problems early. We expect leaders to raise the quality of the work, help colleagues succeed and use AI to remove unnecessary effort.

This is an opportunity to shape a priority market from the beginning, with direct influence on how Light understands customers, takes its product to market and develops its offering.

 

The good stuff

🏢 In-office, five days a week, high talent density.
💸 Competitive salary.
🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays.
🚀 Define what winning looks like in a vertical from the very first deal.
🌍 Regular travel to Copenhagen, Munich, NY, Paris, and wherever Care Homes & Clinics actually do business.
🥳 Off-sites twice a year. The last one was in Italy.

 

How to apply

Tell us about a specialist market you helped grow: how you built the pipeline, earned credibility with customers and partners, and equipped Sales to win. Share a time your analysis changed the plan, and how customer insight shaped a product requirement.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

title: AI Science Writer, Nebius Academy (Contract)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Science Writer, Nebius Academy (Contract) based in United Kingdom. As an AI Science Writer, you’ll translate cutting-edge AI and machine learning research into accurate, engaging, and accessible stories. You’ll work at the intersection of scientific research, technical communication, journalism, and multimedia storytelling. A core part of the role will be reviewing new models, architectures, papers, and research to identify what is genuinely novel and important. You’ll turn complex technical concepts into compelling written and visual narratives through articles, explainers, diagrams, charts, and other formats. You’ll engage directly with researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to investigate ideas and verify technical claims. The role also offers opportunities to cover major conferences, host research-focused events, and experiment with AI-assisted editorial workflows. Accountabilities Produce accurate and engaging scientific and technical reviews covering new AI models, architectures, research papers, internal research, and emerging trends. Analyze technical papers and research findings to identify meaningful innovations, understand methodologies, evaluate limitations, and communicate their significance. Transform complex model architectures and technical concepts into clear visual narratives, including infographics, diagrams, charts, and other multimedia elements. Develop written content across multiple formats, including analytical reports, long-form features, interviews, technical explainers, newsletters, webinar scripts, and social media content. Interview researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to uncover insights and provide context for stories. Cover major AI research conferences, emerging fields, significant developments, and important discussions across the AI ecosystem. Host or moderate research webinars, interviews, and other on-camera or multimedia formats. Work directly with researchers to fact-check and verify technical claims while maintaining a clear, engaging editorial voice. Collaborate with designers and multimedia producers on more complex visual and interactive stories. Create visual assets independently where appropriate, using AI tools and other relevant technologies to support the production process. Experiment with AI models, agents, coding, and automation to improve research, editorial, analysis, and visual-production workflows. Contribute to an editorial environment focused on making advanced scientific research accessible without oversimplifying its underlying complexity. Requirements: Professional or academic experience in AI/ML research, machine learning engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. A degree in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, physics, engineering, computational science, or another relevant technical field. Strong ability to read and interpret scientific papers, inspect model architectures, compare experimental results, and discuss technical details directly with researchers. Strong technical writing and editorial skills, with the ability to communicate complex scientific concepts accurately, clearly, and engagingly. Strong visual communication instincts and the ability to explain technical mechanisms through diagrams, infographics, charts, and other multimedia formats. Ability to assess the significance and limitations of research rather than simply summarize findings. Excellent interviewing and communication skills, with confidence engaging researchers, engineers, and technical experts. Comfortable working across multiple content formats and adapting technical material for different audiences and channels. Familiarity with LLMs and AI-assisted content or research workflows, using these tools to enhance productivity while maintaining personal editorial judgement and authorship. Career growth and continuous learning opportunities. Collaboration with researchers, engineers, scientific leaders, designers, and multimedia professionals. description: <p><strong>Job title: Customer Enablement Specialist (12 Month Fixed-Term)</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: Paris</strong></p> <p><strong>Salary: €42,400 - €53,000</strong></p> <p><strong>Team: Client Delivery EMEA</strong></p> <p><strong>Reporting To: Operating Model Design Lead</strong></p> <p><strong><br>This role is based in Paris, France and requires an existing right to work in the EU.</strong></p> <p><strong>At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.<br></strong></p> <p><strong>Please submit your application in English.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><br>Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.</p> <p>Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.</p> <p>With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.</p> <p><strong><br>What will I be doing?</strong></p> <p>In this role, you will be a key driver of our mission to reimagine energy and make net-zero a reality for everyone. As a <strong>Customer Enablement Specialist</strong>, you will be the bridge between our innovative technology and the people who use it. You will empower our clients, partners, and colleagues in French-speaking markets to not only understand our platform but to master it - including the AI-powered capabilities we are continuously building and rolling out. Your work will directly accelerate Kaluza's growth by ensuring our users are confident, capable, and ready to support the energy transition.</p> <p><strong>Strategic Training &amp; Programme Partnership:</strong> Act as a trusted advisor to our clients, partners, and internal teams, performing deep learning needs analysis to understand their unique operational challenges. You'll manage your workstream with genuine project and programme management discipline - planning, sequencing and tracking delivery within complex, multi-stakeholder client programmes, ideally drawing on agile ways of working to stay responsive as scope evolves.</p> <p><strong>Content Creation &amp; Delivery:</strong> You will be the master of making the complex simple. You'll create high-quality, engaging training materials in both <strong>French</strong> and <strong>English</strong>, including interactive workshops, e-learning modules, and quick reference guides - translating not just today's platform, but AI features and products still in development, into training that's ready the moment they go live. You'll deliver these sessions virtually and in-person, inspiring your audience and building their confidence with every interaction.</p> <p><strong>Driving Adoption &amp; Impact:</strong> Your role is to accelerate the adoption of the Kaluza platform. You will provide post-training support and coaching, monitor the effectiveness of your programmes, and continuously iterate based on feedback and performance metrics. You'll ensure our training leads to real-world, positive change for our users and the energy industry.</p> <p><strong><br>About You&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em><strong>Ideally you’ll have/be</strong></em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Bilingual Fluency, to a high standard:</strong> You are fluent in both <strong>French</strong> and <strong>English</strong>, with outstanding written and spoken communication skills - essential for day-to-day stakeholder management across multiple countries, up to and including executive level.</li> <li><strong>Operational &amp; Technical SaaS Training Expertise:</strong> A proven track record designing and delivering training in a SaaS or technology environment, ideally with hands-on experience of operational or technical instructional training rather than generalist L&amp;D delivery.</li> <li><strong>Project &amp; Programme Management Experience:</strong> Strong project and/or programme management experience gained within complex, multi-stakeholder environments; experience of agile delivery is a strong advantage.</li> <li><strong>Operational Experience:</strong> Demonstrable experience gained within an operational environment - energy sector operations and/or contact centre settings are especially valued - giving you a first-hand understanding of the pressures and workflows your training needs to support.</li> <li><strong>AI Fluency:</strong> Demonstrable experience building, productionalising, or delivering training on AI features and products while they are still in development, and genuine confidence working with AI tools as part of your own everyday practice.</li> <li><strong>Simplification Master:</strong> You possess a natural ability to take complex technical and business concepts and translate them into clear, engaging, and practical learning materials.</li> <li><strong>Engaging Facilitator:</strong> You are a confident and dynamic presenter, able to captivate diverse audiences and create a fun, interactive learning environment.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative &amp; Proactive:</strong> You are a team player who builds strong relationships and is proactive in identifying opportunities to support others and drive continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>What will set you apart&nbsp;</strong></em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Energy Sector Acumen:</strong> A practical background in energy utility operations or decarbonisation technologies, beyond the operational experience above, that lets you connect training directly to the real-world challenges our clients face.</li> <li><strong>Proven Training Leadership:</strong> A demonstrated track record of scaling training programmes and an ability to think strategically about how to build and expand a learning culture across an international organisation.</li> </ul> <p><strong><br>Where you'll work</strong></p> <p>We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.</p> <p><strong><br>Kaluza Values</strong></p> <p>Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.</strong></p> <p><strong><br>Our Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Financial &amp; Insurance:</strong> Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life &amp; Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)</li> <li><strong>Allowances:</strong> 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund</li> <li><strong>Time Off &amp; Flexibility:</strong> 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility</li> </ul> <p><strong><br>We want the best people</strong></p> <p>We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.</p> <p>We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.</p> <p>Find out more about working in <a href="http://kaluza.com">Kaluza</a> on our <a href="https://kaluza-dev.webflow.io/careers">careers page</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/kaluza/">LinkedIn</a>. <br><br>You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy <a href="https://www.kaluza.com/applicant-data-protection-notice">here</a>.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Manager MES / Manufacturing Transformation | m/w/d
description: Your mission You’re a team player, authentic, open, and face challenges with a positive mindset? Then you’re a perfect fit for us! Take end-to-end ownership of international MES and Manufacturing Transformation programs – from program setup, governance, solution design, and implementation through to rollout, go-live, and stabilization – while keeping scope, roadmap, budget, resources, risks, and dependencies firmly under control. Across complex multi-site programs, you bring together business functions, IT, Quality, sites, vendors, and system integrators, providing clear direction to project teams throughout demanding and critical phases. Functional projects and workstreams covering process optimization and harmonization, solution design, system integration, data flows, and data migration are managed with confidence, while validation activities can also be supported conceptually at both program and project level. With a comprehensive understanding of the relevant functional and technical concepts, you identify dependencies early and work closely with experts to develop and evaluate robust solutions. Particularly during rollout, readiness, and go-live phases, you drive decisions and follow them through, ensure successful delivery, manage escalations, and represent the program confidently towards management, steering committees, and other relevant stakeholders. Your profile Consulting experience in leading complex international programs and projects within the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry forms the foundation of your expertise. Strong knowledge of MES and Manufacturing IT is complemented by hands-on experience in the implementation, integration, and multi-site rollout of corresponding solutions. Pharmaceutical manufacturing processes and their interfaces with Quality, Automation/OT, ERP/SAP, and other relevant systems are areas in which you are highly confident. A solid understanding of GxP, Computerized Systems Validation, and pharmaceutical Quality processes enables you to translate regulatory requirements effectively into program planning, governance, and delivery. Excellent German and English skills, combined with a willingness to travel internationally, enable you to operate confidently across complex global program environments. Your start with us At our company, you’ll find a work environment where initiative, collaboration, and mutual support are truly valued. You can expect exciting projects, a fair salary, plenty of development opportunities, and a flexible working model tailored to your needs. Your journey with us starts with a well-structured onboarding, including two welcome days at our Frankfurt office, a buddy program, and access to internal networks to help you feel at home from day one. We offer full flexibility with flexible working hours, remote work options, and even the chance to work temporarily from abroad. With 30 vacation days plus additional paid leave for special occasions, as well as a time value account for extended breaks like sabbaticals, we ensure you have the space to recharge and balance life and work. Our internal training curriculum, additional learning formats, and tailored development paths support your individual career goals. Regular events, cross-location networks, and our feedback platform miaX create space for exchange, ideas, and collaboration. We support your well-being with a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership and exclusive perks through our Corporate Benefits platform. You can also privately use your company IT equipment, and stay mobile with flexible options like JobRad, a company car, or a BahnCard. And because we value your network, we reward successful referrals with an attractive bonus. We work in a hybrid model: depending on the project requirements, you will work remotely, in one of our offices or directly at the customer's premises. How to contact us Apply directly or send us your application documents (CV, certificates, desired salary and possible start date) by e-mail to: https://linktr.ee/msgindustryadvisors Do you have questions or need more information about the position or career opportunities at msg industry advisors? Please feel free to contact us: Phone: +49 69 580045-4003 E-mail: Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Esprit d'initiative : Une mentalité proactive avec une capacité démontrée à anticiper les besoins et à agir de manière autonome. Sens de la sécurité : Une solide compréhension (ou une volonté de devenir référent) des normes de sécurité alimentaire et HACCP. Souhaité : Expérience en restauration : Une première expérience opérationnelle dans un environnement de cuisine ou de restaurant. Certifications de sécurité : Formation en premiers secours, sécurité incendie ou sécurité alimentaire (bien qu'une formation puisse être dispensée). Compétences linguistiques : La maîtrise de l'anglais est un plus pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez Deliveroo, vous ferez un travail qui compte, en résolvant des problèmes concrets dans une marketplace tripartite en constante évolution. Nous sommes des passionnés de cuisine, des solveurs de problèmes et des créateurs de liens, unis par une volonté commune d'améliorer les choses. En travaillant ici, vous pouvez vous attendre à : 🔧 Avoir un impact visible chaque jour Votre travail améliore directement l'expérience des clients, des partenaires et des livreurs. 🌱 Apprendre vite dans un environnement entrepreneurial Travaillez au plus près du marché avec autonomie, rapidité et de réelles responsabilités. 🧠 Construire une carrière, pas seulement un poste Dépassez-vous, développez de nouvelles compétences et évoluez en même temps que l'entreprise. 🌎 Réussir ensemble dans une culture inclusive Des équipes collaboratives et guidées par des valeurs, qui soutiennent votre façon de travailler. Nous visons à créer un processus équitable qui laisse briller vos compétences — notre parcours de recrutement comprend généralement 3 à 4 étapes. Pour en savoir plus sur notre façon de recruter, cliquez ici . Notre structure mondiale Deliveroo fait désormais partie de DoorDash, réunissant des équipes avec une portée, une échelle et une ambition encore plus grandes. Selon votre rôle, vous pourrez collaborer avec des collègues, des systèmes et des dirigeants à travers DoorDash et Wolt. Ensemble, nous débloquons de nouvelles possibilités en tant qu'équipe mondiale unique. Diversité, Équité et Inclusion Chez Deliveroo, nous savons qu'un lieu de travail exceptionnel reflète le monde qui nous entoure et que la diversité et l'inclusion nous rendent plus forts, plus créatifs et meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons. Tu rejoins le pôle Mise en Location au sein de notre équipe Gestion Locative (une dizaine de collaborateurs). Ton objectif est stratégique : garantir à nos bailleurs la meilleure expérience possible dès leur premier contact avec Matera, pour un onboarding fluide, rapide et sans accroc. Accompagné·e par Elodie (Team Lead Mise en location), tu seras le premier point de contact opérationnel pour onboarder un nouveau client ! Tes missions : Inviter et relancer les clients pour le paramétrage de leur.s bien.s sur leur espace Matera. Vérifier les informations saisies et récupérer les documents manquants auprès du client. Valider avec le client le bilan d'ouverture (soldes locataires, dépôt de garantie). Réaliser les calls de kick-off et les calls relances. Assurer le suivi administratif du dossier. En parallèle, tu seras accompagné·e par ta manager et l’équipe sur des formations spécifiques au département Gestion Locative : formation sur les process de l’équipe, le fonctionnement de la plateforme, le traitement des demandes clients, etc. À la fin de ton stage, tu sauras parfaitement piloter le suivi d’un dossier client de A à Z : de l’accompagnement des clients dans le paramétrage de leurs biens à la vérification des informations et documents, en passant par le suivi administratif, les échanges avec les clients et la gestion de leurs demandes. Le tout en contribuant à offrir une expérience client fluide, réactive et positive. raw.description:
Après le succès de ses offres de syndic de copropriétés, Matera a lancé son offre de gestion locative début 2023 et compte désormais plus de 2000 biens !

Concrètement, Matera propose aux propriétaires-bailleurs une gestion locative complète, prise en charge par un interlocuteur unique : loyers, charges, sinistres, mise en location, fiscalité et même la vente du bien. Contrairement à une agence traditionnelle, Matera s'appuie sur l'innovation et l'automatisation pour être plus réactive et plus transparente, tout en laissant à chaque propriétaire la liberté de choisir son niveau d'implication.

Tu rejoins le pôle Mise en Location au sein de notre équipe Gestion Locative (une dizaine de collaborateurs).

Ton objectif est stratégique : garantir à nos bailleurs la meilleure expérience possible dès leur premier contact avec Matera, pour un onboarding fluide, rapide et sans accroc.

Accompagné·e par Elodie (Team Lead Mise en location), tu seras le premier point de contact opérationnel pour onboarder un nouveau client !

Tes missions :

  • Inviter et relancer les clients pour le paramétrage de leur.s bien.s sur leur espace Matera.

  • Vérifier les informations saisies et récupérer les documents manquants auprès du client.

  • Valider avec le client le bilan d'ouverture (soldes locataires, dépôt de garantie).

  • Réaliser les calls de kick-off et les calls relances.

  • Assurer le suivi administratif du dossier.

  • Nous aider à assurer le service et support clients : répondre aux questions et aider les clients et locataires dans leurs démarches, tout cela avec un maximum de dynamisme et de positivité pour offrir la meilleure expérience possible

  • Participer à la construction des process de l’équipe

Onboarding et montée en compétence :

Ton parcours d’intégration commence par deux semaines de rencontres avec l’ensemble de nos équipes pour comprendre comment nous sommes organisés en interne et notre vision. En parallèle, tu seras accompagné·e par ta manager et l’équipe sur des formations spécifiques au département Gestion Locative : formation sur les process de l’équipe, le fonctionnement de la plateforme, le traitement des demandes clients, etc.

À la fin de ton stage, tu sauras parfaitement piloter le suivi d’un dossier client de A à Z : de l’accompagnement des clients dans le paramétrage de leurs biens à la vérification des informations et documents, en passant par le suivi administratif, les échanges avec les clients et la gestion de leurs demandes. Le tout en contribuant à offrir une expérience client fluide, réactive et positive.

Les avantages :

Les plus :

  • Gratification : 1000€ ou 1200€ (stage de fin d’études de master) brut par mois,

  • 2 semaines d'onboarding pour comprendre le fonctionnement et les valeurs de Matera, et un onboarding spécifique à ton métier,

  • Un suivi hebdomadaire pour t’accompagner dans ta montée en compétences

  • Sport : accès à Wellpass (exGymlib), pour faire du sport à petits prix,

  • Des bons plans culture avec la plateforme Leeto (réductions cinéma, musées, parcs d'attraction...),

La base légale :

  • Une demi-journée de congé par mois (cumulable)

  • Carte Swile - pris en charge à 50%

  • Prise en charge des transports à 50%

  • Un ordinateur et équipements te seront fournis

Les informations pratiques :

  • Localisation : Paris 10e

  • Télétravail : occasionnel sous validation du manager

  • Type de contrat : stage de 6 mois - Temps plein

  • Date de démarrage : début décembre


Idéalement,

  • Tu suis des études en immobilier (ou dans un domaine proche), tu recherches un stage de 6 mois ou tu as déjà travaillé en relation client

  • Tu as un excellent relationnel, tu es empathique, à l’écoute et à l’aise au téléphone,

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris. Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée. Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage. Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM. À propos du projet PLEIADES Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM. Vos principales missions seront de : Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en génie électrique, communications, photonique, traitement du signal ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en systèmes et réseaux de transmission optique ainsi qu’en traitement numérique du signal (DSP) appliqué aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique. La maîtrise de MATLAB et/ou Python pour le développement d’algorithmes DSP sera appréciée. Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes à l’aise dans un environnement multiculturel, notamment pour encadrer des stagiaires et/ou des étudiants. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable. Vous disposez également de bonnes qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des informations complexes. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). Vous bénéficierez de : 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT) flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service) télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75% Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne... A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé Informations diverses : Date limite de candidature : 30 novembre 2026 Type d'emploi : CDD de 18 mois Description de poste ici Rémunération : 36 000 euros brut/an Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. raw.title: Comercial de Software B2B | IA y Transformación Digital
raw.description:
El Puesto

Serás responsable de impulsar el crecimiento comercial de nuestras soluciones ERP, software de gestión, movilidad, planificación, RR. HH. e Inteligencia Artificial en clientes nuevos y existentes. Trabajarás en un entorno B2B tecnológico, con ciclos de venta consultivos y clientes de tamaño medio y grande, colaborando estrechamente con los equipos de producto, consultoría, marketing y dirección.

Inteligencia Artificial: una parte importante de tu trabajo
En Freematica estamos incorporando la IA como una nueva capa de valor sobre nuestras soluciones y también como herramienta para transformar nuestra propia forma de trabajar.

Por ello, buscamos una persona que tenga interés real por la Inteligencia Artificial y sea capaz de incorporarla a su actividad comercial.

Utilizarás herramientas de IA para:

  • Mejorar la prospección y segmentación de cuentas
  • Preparar reuniones y analizar información de clientes
  • Identificar necesidades y oportunidades de negocio
  • Personalizar mensajes y propuestas comerciales
  • Analizar conversaciones, oportunidades y pipeline
  • Automatizar tareas comerciales y administrativas
  • Generar contenidos y argumentarios comerciales
  • Obtener insights a partir de datos y actividad comercial
  • Explorar nuevos casos de uso de IA aplicables a nuestros clientes y sectores
No buscamos necesariamente un perfil técnico de IA. Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, criterio y capacidad para entender cómo aplicar la tecnología y la IA para conseguir mejores resultados comerciales y aportar más valor al cliente.


Responsabilidades

  • Dominar rápidamente nuestro producto: comprender en profundidad nuestras soluciones, módulos, arquitectura básica y principales casos de uso para poder mantener conversaciones de valor tanto con perfiles de negocio como técnicos
  • Venta consultiva B2B: analizar los procesos, necesidades y retos del cliente, entender su modelo operativo y proponer la solución tecnológica que mejor responda a sus objetivos
  • Prospección y generación de negocio: identificar empresas objetivo, detectar oportunidades, realizar contactos iniciales, cualificar leads y desarrollar nuevas cuentas
  • Discovery y análisis de necesidades: preparar y dirigir reuniones de descubrimiento, identificar pain points, interlocutores, procesos, necesidades y criterios de decisión
  • Presentaciones y demos comerciales: presentar nuestras soluciones de forma orientada al negocio, adaptando el discurso a cada sector y perfil interlocutor
  • Diseño y seguimiento del proceso comercial: trabajar con un proceso estructurado y un pipeline definido: prospección → cualificación → discovery → demo → propuesta → negociación → cierre
  • Gestión rigurosa del CRM: mantener Salesforce actualizado, registrar actividad, próximos pasos, probabilidad de cierre, interlocutores y cualquier información relevante de las oportunidades
  • Forecast comercial: realizar previsiones de ventas rigurosas, identificar riesgos y mantener actualizado el estado real de cada oportunidad
  • Elaboración de propuestas a medida: coordinarte con los equipos de producto, consultoría y tecnología para transformar las necesidades detectadas en propuestas claras, viables y competitivas
  • Gestión de cuentas y crecimiento: detectar oportunidades de ampliación, nuevas soluciones, servicios y funcionalidades dentro de nuestra base instalada


Requisitos

  • Experiencia previa de 4-6 años o más en venta consultiva B2B de tecnología, preferiblemente en ERP, software de gestión empresarial, SaaS, Cloud, IT o soluciones digitales
  • Alta capacidad de aprendizaje técnico: comodidad trabajando con productos complejos y capacidad para traducir funcionalidades tecnológicas a beneficios de negocio
  • Experiencia en procesos de venta consultiva y ciclos comerciales B2B
  • Mentalidad de proceso y orientación a métricas
  • Experiencia trabajando con CRM (preferiblemente Salesforce), pipeline, forecast y metodologías comerciales estructuradas
  • Rigor en el seguimiento de oportunidades y reporting
  • Orientación a resultados y al cierre, manteniendo una visión de relación a largo plazo con el cliente
  • Capacidad para mantener conversaciones con diferentes interlocutores: dirección, operaciones, RR. HH., administración, IT, etc.
  • Autonomía y proactividad:
    • Capacidad para organizar tu agenda y priorizar cuentas
    • Iniciativa para generar oportunidades y abrir nuevas puertas
    • Capacidad para tomar decisiones y avanzar sin supervisión constante
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación y negociación
  • Interés y conocimientos prácticos en Inteligencia Artificial y herramientas de productividad basadas en IA
  • Residencia en España y disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales a clientes y oficinas
Se valorará muy positivamente
  • Formación en áreas tecnológicas, empresariales o similares: Ingeniería, ADE, Economía, Informática, etc.
  • Experiencia previa en software empresarial, ERP o SaaS B2B
  • Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital o implantación de soluciones de gestión
  • Conocimiento de los sectores de Limpieza, Facility, Seguridad, Servicios, Outsourcing o Instalaciones, o sectores con modelos operativos similares
  • Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA generativa como ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude u otras herramientas similares aplicadas al trabajo diario
  • Conocimientos sobre automatización de procesos, agentes de IA, análisis de datos o aplicación de IA a procesos empresariales
  • Experiencia trabajando con equipos de Marketing y Product
  • Conocimiento de metodologías de venta consultiva y frameworks comerciales
  • Experiencia con Salesforce u otros CRM
  • Nivel de inglés suficiente para trabajar con documentación técnica y tecnológica


Tus ventajas

  • Incorporarte a una compañía sólida, con más de 28 años desarrollando software propio de gestión empresarial y una base estable de clientes en toda España
  • Trabajar con un producto tecnológico real, complejo y con un amplio recorrido de evolución
  • Participar en un momento especialmente interesante de transformación de nuestro producto, con el desarrollo de nuevas soluciones basadas en movilidad, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial
  • Formar parte de un equipo técnico y especializado donde tu opinión puede influir tanto en el producto como en la estrategia comercial
  • Oportunidad real de crecimiento profesional en el área comercial y de desarrollo de negocio
  • Entorno donde se valoran la iniciativa, la autonomía, el rigor y la capacidad de aportar
  • Acompañamiento inicial para que puedas conocer nuestro producto, nuestros sectores y nuestra metodología comercial
  • Condiciones competitivas acordes a la experiencia aportada, con fijo + variable por objetivos


Esperamos recibir su solicitud.

Más que un perfil que simplemente "venda software", buscamos a una persona que quiera convertirse en referente comercial de nuestras soluciones. Alguien capaz de sentarse con un cliente, entender cómo funciona su negocio, detectar dónde están sus problemas, explicar cómo puede ayudar la tecnología y construir una propuesta que tenga sentido tanto operativa como económicamente.Y, especialmente, alguien que entienda que la IA no es solo una tecnología más, sino una nueva forma de trabajar, vender y aportar valor a nuestros clientes.Si te motiva vender soluciones tecnológicas complejas, disfrutas entendiendo el negocio del cliente, tienes curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA y te gusta construir relaciones comerciales basadas en confianza, conocimiento y resultados, nos encantará conocerte.Envíanos tu CV y cuéntanos brevemente qué proyectos de venta consultiva tecnológica has liderado, qué tipo de soluciones has vendido y cómo estás utilizando actualmente la IA en tu trabajo.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description: Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here. We are looking for an engaged and passionate Staff Engineer to join our growing engineering department and be a technical leader across our engineering teams.   As a Staff Engineer , you will be responsible for driving influence across teams and domains, leading solution delivery on cross-functional and strategic initiatives, and serving as a technical leader within the engineering organization. You will ensure the set quality standards and drive the adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps.   Quality, excellence, and agility drive our delivery processes and you will help us level these up. Using NodeJS and Typescript back-end stacks, appropriate for each requirement, but always hosted on AWS , we build added value and resilient services on top of voice and fully integrate with our customers’ business critical tools (CRM, Helpdesk, E-Commerce, …).   Your mission @ Aircall: Lead transversal, complex projects, fully autonomously from ideation to completion, starting from a high-level problem statement. Proactively communicate the technical vision across multiple teams, ensuring alignment and sharing knowledge across domains. Act as a go-to expert, providing mentorship and guidance across teams. Deeply understand multiple product domains; proactively identify improvements and advocate for customer needs across the company. Lead and define technical strategies for complex, impactful problems. Set and uphold higher quality standards and drive adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps. Writes production-ready code, finding appropriate solutions for medium complexity challenges; participates in software design discussions; demonstrates a good understanding of system infrastructure and DevOps principles; contributes to performance and quality within their scope; applies a security-first mindset.   A little about you: A little about you:You have extensive experience (e.g., 10+ years) in back-end development, using TypeScript & NodeJS/Python/Ruby/Rails or other languages, with a focus on delivering for security, scalability, availability, and performance across multiple domains. You lead and define technical strategies, demonstrating a strong understanding of system design to solve complex, impactful problems. You are comfortable leading the development of complex projects affecting multiple teams and domains , driving initiatives from ideation to completion. You are an expert at identifying opportunities for new impactful initiatives. You have a deep understanding of multiple product domains and can anticipate long-term needs. You possess effective and proactive communication skills, and can collaborate with different profiles and roles to ensure cross-domain alignment. Our Tech Stack: You do not need to be familiar with all of our technical stack or any specific functional area, but you have a strong willingness to learn and adapt quickly. Typescript/Node.js, Python, REST API/GraphQL APIs, Ruby/Rails, React AWS/Serverless or EKS, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Redis Why join us? 🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities 💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall 📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit 🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset 💶 Competitive salary package & benefits DE&I Statement:  At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey.  We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.   We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn. Want to know more about candidate privacy? Find our Candidate Privacy Notice here. title: Onboard Software Engineer - Peripheral Services
description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the Hub’s onboard computers, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit. The Peripheral Services team owns the software that integrates third-party devices and payloads into Loft’s standardized satellite platform. We enable the control and monitoring of many key spacecraft components, including optical payloads, radios, power controllers, and GNSS receivers. Many of these components are reused across all satellite programs and form the building blocks of our onboard architecture. The applications developed by our team handle the low-level communication protocol details, exposing the connected devices behind standardized APIs used across mission operations. The team is also responsible for the automation and orchestration that allows Loft to safely and reliably operate the equipment at scale. In this role, you’ll help develop the software that connects diverse spacecraft hardware to the rest of the platform, and ultimately enables successful missions in orbit. About this role: Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability. Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase. Design and implement unit and integration tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code. Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches. Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards. Coordinate with downstream teams on the distribution and adoption of the latest releases. In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites. Must Haves: 3+ years' software engineering experience, using programming languages including C/C++ (C++11 or newer) and Python. Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows Experience with continuous integration tools (GitLab-CI, Jenkins, or similar). Knowledge of build systems (e.g., Make, CMake). Understanding of distributed architecture. Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP , TCP, IP) and POSIX standards. Experience in developing multi-threaded applications. Previous team leader or manager role Nice to Haves: Familiarity with additional programming languages, such as Go or Rust. Experience with embedded Linux operation, including Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms. Proficiency with unit test frameworks (e.g., pytest, Googletest, Unity) Experience with middleware framework (gRPC, ZMQ / NATS , etc.) Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, K3S , systemd-nspawn) Experience with space systems and concepts Some of Our Awesome Benefits: Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best Health and life insurance, we care about your health Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand ) Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable   * Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications.
